There are 9 invoices sharing the root cause 'vendor_master_cost_center', with a combined total of $23,782.80. All invoices are within the AP clerk's approval authority.

The proposed correction is to update the vendor master's cost centre from CC-410 to CC-430, then re-post the invoices. This single correction will clear every failed invoice from the same vendor.

This action is authorised under policy FIN-AP-03, which allows the AP clerk to correct a vendor master field and re-post the affected invoices, provided each invoice is under the per-invoice approval limit.
